evals.prompt: We've been debugging a race condition in the PR poller for the last hour. Write a handoff so I can continue this tomorrow in a fresh session.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file at .agent/{branch}/handoff.md with Goal, Current state, Plan/next steps, Key files, and Decisions & gotchas sections, curated from what actually happened — not a transcript. Clipboard copy attempted. One-line pointer returned, not the whole doc.
assertions: Writes to .agent/{branch}/handoff.md, resolving the branch via git
Includes exact file paths and run commands, not vague references
Excludes raw tool-call transcripts and conversational chit-chat
Attempts pbcopy and reports success or graceful skip
Returns a one-line pointer to the file, not the full document

evals.expected_output: A handoff scoped to only the auth-refactor thread of work, stating the focus scope in one line before writing.
assertions: States the chosen scope (focused on auth refactor) before writing
Includes only material on the named thread

evals.expected_output: A condensed handoff: Goal, next steps, and top-3 files only.
assertions: Produces a condensed document, not the full five-section version
No secrets, tokens, or credentials written to the file
